messages:
anika: Hey — saw a spike in fncall validation rejects around 11:12p UTC. Logs show a lot of partial/streaming tool responses failing the schema check because the validator ran on intermediate chunks. Is this expected with streaming enabled?

devops-bot: alert: fncall.validation.rejects spike (service: invoke-gateway, region: eu-west). 120 rejects in 5m, 87 tagged as 'partial-json'.

kevin: hmm we intentionally validate on every chunk for streaming so we can stop early on obvious errors. But that means truncated JSON during transmission looks like a hard reject.

sara: can we distinguish "intermediate chunk" vs final frame in the validator? The protocol includes a "final": true flag on the last event.

ryan: the gateway does expose that. Problem is the validator runs inside the streaming parser which sees fragments before final. We could delay strict schema enforcement until final, and run lightweight linting during the stream.

anika: delaying strict enforcement seems sensible, but two concerns: 1) if the model is steadily producing invalid shapes we won't detect it early and might waste downstream tool time; 2) dashboard/alerts will no longer see early failures which are useful signal.

liz-ux: from console UX POV operators want to know "streaming-fncall stability" separately from final rejects. Maybe two metrics: stream-fragment-warnings and final-schema-rejects. Dashboards should show both.

matt: +1. Also need to think about quota/billing semantics: currently a final reject counts as an fncall request and sometimes falls back to text generation which is billed differently. If we start soft-warn on fragments, do we change attribution?

kevin: proposal: change validator to three states for streaming flows: PASS (chunk-level heuristics ok), WARN (fragment looks off but wait for final), FAIL_FINAL (enforce on final only). Emit telemetry tags: streaming_hint=pass|warn and validation_final=pass|fail.

sara: we should also sample full request/response bodies (redacted) for WARN cases so engineers can triage without overloading storage. Maybe 1% by default, configurable per team.

ryan: ops notes: for rollout, we can gate strict->deferred validation behind feature flag stream-validate-v2. Start at 0% on production, 10% on canary, measure two key metrics over 24h: final_schema_reject_rate and tool_success_rate (calls returning success code).

anika: agreed. For dashboards: add chart that overlays final_schema_reject_rate and streaming_warn_rate. Also add an alert rule: if final_schema_reject_rate increases >0.5% absolute with concurrent decrease in tool_success_rate by >2% then rollback.

matt: Regarding quota attribution: current billing events use route_id + invocation_mode (fncall vs text). If we fallback from fncall to text at runtime we attribute to text. But customers complain about unexpected charges when model couldn't produce valid tool JSON. Could add a "fallback_reason" field in billing events and surface it in Cost Explorer.

liz-ux: yes expose fallback_reason in console and allow filtering. Also include example payloads for customers to debug prompt fixes.

kevin: Implementation plan draft:
1) validator change: chunk heuristics -> emit streaming_hint; defer strict JSON schema validation until final frame for flows flagged as streaming.
2) Telemetry: add tags streaming_hint, validation_final, fallback_reason. Add sampling for WARNs.
3) Dashboard: new panels for streaming_warn_rate, final_schema_reject_rate, tool_success_rate, canary slice.
4) Billing: attach fallback_reason to billing event; UI change in Cost Explorer.
5) Rollout: feature flag stream-validate-v2 with canary percentages and automatic backoff.

anika: timeline?

kevin: I can PR validator changes this week. Telemetry + sampling needs sig from eng-infra, will take 1 sprint. Dashboards + Cost Explorer work needs 2 sprints. Rollout and canary gating done after infra metrics are live.

ryan: quick technical note — ensure streaming parser can mark frames with is_final. For SSE style streams the final event is explicit; for HTTP/2 chunked it may be ambiguous. We'll add a conservative buffer: if a connection closes without final flag, treat last chunk as final and run validation then. Emit connection_close_reason tag.

sara: testing: add unit tests for fragmented payloads, e2e on canary with simulated slow network to reproduce intermediate-chunk behavior.

matt: action items for this thread:
- kevin: PR validator heuristics (1743219000)
- eng-infra: add telemetry fields + sampling (assign TBD)
- console: add streaming/fallback panels (liz-ux + matt)
- billing: attach fallback_reason (finance eng)
- qa: setup canary test harness for fragment simulation

anika: thanks all. I'll create a followup ticket linking this thread and the PR once kevin posts. If anyone has objections to the deferred-final validation approach, speak now.

kevin: posting PR in 30m, will include changelog and migration notes.

devops-bot: deploybot: canary deploy scheduled for stream-validate-v2 -> 10% traffic at 2024-05-02T02:00:00Z.

sara: will monitor the sampled WARN payloads. tagging @kevin for triage.

ryan: copy. I'll add a synthetic load test that injects partial fragments to the canary cluster.

anika: closing for now — followups in the ticket. :thumbsup:
